objective: Return the items on the Bonegrip's Note to Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge.

description: Yagyin's Digest, eh?  Are you starting a new chapter of us, somewhere?  Never mind, it is not my place to ask.
I will help you, for I have an extra copy.  We must aid each other, yes?  That is how we flourish.
I require three items of power.  Bring them to me and I will give you the digest.
I will not speak their names.  Ears may be on us.  But here, I will write them down.
progress: Do you have the relics for which I asked?
completion: You are resourceful, <class>. If it truly is your charge to begin a new chapter of our order, then I believe you will run it well.
